label: übernehmen

edition.check: Level 5: barcode 888837168625 (UPC-A, checksum valid per tl-gtin) matches this edition in >=2 independent sources: MET. MusicBrainz f6758afb lists barcode 0888837168625 with Columbia 88883716862, and Discogs 4729785 (Europe, BIEM/GEMA, LC 00162) lists 888837168625. The CAA back-cover read also shows 8 8883-71686-2 5. Format CD and artist Daft Punk match: MET. No other edition with the same barcode has a different tracklist: MET. All barcode hits are 13-track CDs with the same order (MB search shows 5 releases with 13 tracks; Discogs AU 4581879 is identical). The Russian cassette is a different format and unofficial. The iTunes '14 Tracks' header lists only 13 tracks and refers to a digital product, not a CD edition.
edition.summary: The barcode matches exactly in MusicBrainz and Discogs (EU/GEMA CD), and every same-barcode CD edition shares the identical 13-track list.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >=2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles: MET. MusicBrainz f6758afb, Discogs 4729785 and the back-cover image read all give the same 13 titles in the same order. The only differences are capitalisation and apostrophe variants (Doin’ It Right / Doin' it Right).
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz, Discogs and the read back cover agree on 13 tracks in identical order, differing only in spelling.

sources.check: Level 5: a database plus an independent primary source of the same edition. The databases are MusicBrainz and Discogs: MET. The primary source is the back-cover print read via vision; it shows barcode 8 8883-71686-2 5, LC 00162 and 'Made in the EU', matching the Discogs EU entry: MET. The image is hosted on CAA linked to the MB entry, but Discogs is independent of it, so a database plus primary source pairing still holds.
sources.summary: Two independent databases plus a read back-cover print of the same EU edition.

concerns: The MB search output lists f6758afb as FR 2013-05-20, while the release call shows DE 2013-05-17; the agent reports country DE without addressing this inconsistency.
Track artists (feat. credits, tracks 5-8, 11, 12) appear only in the iTunes output, yet the track sources list only MusicBrainz and Discogs.

Track 13 'Contact': 384 s is taken from MusicBrainz, but Discogs and iTunes both give 381 s. The reasoning's claim that iTunes confirms durations within ±1–2 s is therefore not accurate for this track, and dur_conflicts=0 overlooks it.
The iTunes header says '14 Tracks' but lists 13; this is unexplained, though it does not affect the CD edition.
